task: Support escalation: when a customer cancels an order after paying, the refund is issued correctly but the reserved units are never returned to stock, so popular items drift permanently out of stock; cancelling before payment restocks correctly. Diagnose the root cause and fix it in src/orders.mjs, preserving the rest of the order lifecycle contract exactly: a refund is issued for paid cancellations and only for paid cancellations, invalid transitions (for example cancelling a shipped order, cancelling twice, or paying a cancelled order) keep throwing, and the happy path to delivered is unaffected. Verify your fix with the repository test suite.
